# Redaction evaluation (generated by `python3 eval/redaction_eval.py`)

Fixtures are FAKE secrets built in `eval/redaction_fixtures.py`. The fixtures and the redactor were written by the same author (and the redactor was tuned until they passed), so recall here is an optimistic upper bound, not a guarantee. Not covered: secrets in languages/encodings not in the fixtures, secrets split across separate findings, non-Latin lookalikes beyond Cyrillic/Greek.

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Adversarial fixtures | 63 |
| Secret removed (recall) | 63/63 = 1.000 |
| Leaked fixtures | none |
| Benign snippets | 30 |
| Over-redacted benign snippets | 1/30 = 0.033 |
| Over-redacted examples | "mac = 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff'" |
| Randomised property test (known secret shapes) | 400/400 removed |
